senses: adj. 深色的,黑色的,隐藏的

ex.en: The room grew dark as the storm cut off electricity across the entire district.
ex.zh: 暴风雨切断了整个街区的电力，房间渐渐暗了下来。

ex.en: The power failure plunged the whole city into darkness for nearly three hours.
ex.zh: 停电使整座城市陷入黑暗近三个小时。

senses: n. 破折号(c)；短跑(c)；(of)少量,少许(添加物)
v. 猛冲,突进；猛击,猛撞,猛摔

ex.en: The team also controlled the data to check ancestry of subjects.
ex.zh: 同时,研究小组通过对数据进行检验来核查研究对象的血统。

ex.en: It is essential to protect your personal data.
ex.zh: 保护你的个人数据至关重要。

ex.en: The researchers looked at data that included measurements of lean muscle and abdominal fat from more than 4,000 middle-to-older-aged men.
ex.zh: 研究人员查看了包括4000多名中老年男性的肌肉和腹部脂肪的测量数据。

database.usage: 组合词：data(数据)+base(大本营)→数据库；索引p406

ex.en: The hospital's new database allows doctors to retrieve a patient's records within seconds.
ex.zh: 医院的新数据库使医生能在几秒钟内调出病人的记录。

ex.en: Please confirm the delivery date before signing the contract with the supplier.
ex.zh: 与供应商签订合同之前，请确认交货日期。

ex.en: Their daughter, a recent medical graduate, has joined a rural clinic as a volunteer.
ex.zh: 他们的女儿刚从医学院毕业，已作为志愿者加入一家乡村诊所。

senses: adj. 使人气馁的；令人畏惧的
vi. 破晓；开始,展现；(on,upon)逐渐明白
dawn.usage: 黎明dawn的时候他们开始往山下down走了

ex.en: Peace marked a new dawn in the country's history.
ex.zh: 和平使这个国家的历史翻开了新的一页。

ex.en: We set out at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic on the motorway.
ex.zh: 我们黎明出发，以避开高速公路上的拥堵车流。

ex.en: The dawn of the internet age transformed the way companies do business.
ex.zh: 互联网时代的开端改变了企业的经营方式。

ex.en: Sales rose steadily day by day as news of the product spread across social media.
ex.zh: 随着该产品的消息在社交媒体上传开，销量一天天稳步上升。

daylight.usage: day+light→日光;daylight saving time(=daylight time)夏令时;daylight robbery漫天要价,敲竹杠

senses: vt. (强光等)使目眩,耀眼;使惊奇,使倾倒
n. 耀眼的光,闪耀物;令人赞叹的东西
n. 耀眼炫目；令人眼花缭乱；令人眼花缭乱的东西（或特性）
dazzle.usage: 派生:dazzling adj.眩目的;艳丽的;非凡的；发音类似“带走”→这里的东西“耀眼炫目”，所以很吸引人，大家都想带走。

ex.en: He was momentarily dazzled by the strong sunlight.
ex.zh: 强烈的阳光使他一时睁不开眼。

ex.en: The audience was dazzled by the young pianist's brilliant performance.
ex.zh: 观众被年轻钢琴家精彩的演奏折服。

ex.en: The dazzle of the camera lights made it hard for her to see the stage.
ex.zh: 摄影灯光的耀眼令她难以看清舞台。

ex.en: The battery was completely dead, so the alarm failed to sound during the night.
ex.zh: 电池完全没电了，所以警报在夜间没有响起。

senses: n. 截止日期,最后期限
n. 截止日期，最后期限
deadline.usage: dead(死亡的)+line(线)→最后期限；dead（死亡）+line（线）→死亡线→最后的那条线→截止日期。；组合记忆：dead(死亡的)+line(线)→死亡的线→最后期限→截止日期；索引p406

ex.en: Assign responsibilities around the house and make sure homework deadlines are met.
ex.zh: 给他们布置一些家务活并确保他们能按时完成家庭作业。

ex.en: The committee extended the deadline for applications by two weeks.
ex.zh: 委员会将申请截止期限延长了两周。

ex.en: Working late to meet the deadline, she skipped dinner altogether.
ex.zh: 为了赶上截止期限而工作到深夜，她干脆没吃晚饭。

ex.en: Tight deadlines are a common source of stress in journalism.
ex.zh: 紧迫的截稿期限是新闻行业的常见压力来源。

senses: adj. 致命的；极度的；枯燥的
deadly.usage: dead(死亡的)+ly(形容词后缀)→致命的

ex.en: The lecture was absolutely deadly.
ex.zh: 这讲座简直无聊透了。

deaf.usage: 助记:dead(死去的)dean(系主任)是个deaf(聋子)

ex.en: The charity funds sign-language classes so that deaf children can attend mainstream schools.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构资助手语课程，使聋童能够进入主流学校就读。

phrases.m: 经营某物;沉溺于某事物

deal.usage: make/close a deal with sb.达成交易;deal out分发某物；a big deal一件大事；A deal is a deal.一言为定/言出必行。；索引p406

ex.en: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain's National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.
ex.zh: 关于英国国民医疗服务体系与DeepMind间交易的风险的任何公正评估都必须先承认,双方的本意都是好的。

ex.en: Critics say the big companies use such deals to buy their most threatening potential competitors before their businesses have a chance to gain momentum.
ex.zh: 批评人士说，这些大公司利用此类交易，在最具威胁的潜在竞争企业有机会获得发展势头之前对其进行收购。

ex.en: After weeks of negotiation, the two sides finally struck a deal on trade.
ex.zh: 经过数周谈判，双方最终就贸易达成协议。

ex.en: The art dealer refused to reveal how much the painting had actually cost him.
ex.zh: 这位艺术品交易商拒绝透露这幅画实际花费了他多少钱。

senses: n. (在某些大学中的)学监,系主任
dean.usage: 派生deanery n.教长、主任牧师的办公室或住宅

ex.en: During the war even basic goods were dear, and queues formed outside every shop.
ex.zh: 战争期间连基本商品都很昂贵，每家商店门口都排起了长队。

dearth.usage: n.缺乏 人类ultimate 的理想社会就是utopia，但是关于它的verbal 描绘都是vague 的。在乌托邦，社会财富大量 accumulation，没有来自aristocratic 阶层的压迫和violence，没有对于不公平的；索引p406

ex.en: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch's daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the "unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions".
ex.zh: 两年前，鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白指出，"令人不安的是，诚信缺失问题广泛存在于我们的很多机构中"。

ex.en: The region's dearth of skilled workers has discouraged foreign investors.
ex.zh: 该地区技术工人的匮乏使外国投资者望而却步。

ex.en: A dearth of reliable data makes it hard to judge the policy's true effects.
ex.zh: 可靠数据的缺乏使人难以判断这项政策的真实效果。

senses: n. [U] 毁灭；生命的终止；死亡状态

ex.en: The death of the coal industry transformed the economy of the entire valley.
ex.zh: 煤炭工业的消亡改变了整个山谷的经济。

debate.usage: 尤指正式的讨论、辩论；辨析:debate公开辩论;argue说理论证;discuss交换看法;dispute互相辩驳;quarrel争吵；de（往下）+bate（联想成beat"打"）→把对手往下打压→争论，辩论；辨析：argue侧重争吵、言辞激烈；debate指为做决定/找办法的较正式讨论；dispute侧重为争夺而

ex.en: But it can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes eye contact that signals hostility.
ex.zh: 但它也可能是敌对的,比如当一个政治候选人在辩论中转向其竞争对手,投去敌视的目光。

ex.en: The debate over the EU's single currency is stuck because the dominant powers are busy handling their own crises.
ex.zh: 关于欧盟单一货币的讨论陷入了僵局，因为几个主要国家都在忙于应对自身的危机。

senses: n. 债务；欠款；负债状态
debt.usage: deb（负债）+t→负债；[族] debtor n. 债务人；[近] loan n. 借款；[族]debtor n. 债务人；派生debtor n.债务人；n.欠款，债务；词根:deb(owe欠)+t→欠钱→债务；索引p406

ex.en: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
ex.zh: 试图掌握新技能的专业人士将能够在不负债的情况下实现这一诉求。

ex.en: The government must borrow heavily to cover its growing debt.
ex.zh: 政府必须大量举债以应付不断增长的债务。

ex.en: Graduates often spend a decade paying off their student debts.
ex.zh: 毕业生往往要花十年时间偿还学生贷款。

ex.en: The company reduced its debt by selling several overseas branches.
ex.zh: 该公司通过出售几家海外分部减少了债务。

senses: n. (演员、运动员)首次亮相;初次登台
n. (演员等的)初次登台，首次亮相；(歌手的)首张专辑

ex.en: The young pianist made her debut at the concert hall at the age of sixteen.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家十六岁时在这座音乐厅首次登台。

ex.en: Over the past decade, the proportion of students studying abroad has nearly doubled.
ex.zh: 在过去十年里，出国留学的学生比例几乎翻了一番。

senses: vi. 腐朽,腐烂;失去权力,活力,影响等
vi. (力量、影响等)衰减；腐烂；衰落

ex.en: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
ex.zh: 在接下来的25年里，伊丽莎白时期戏剧的发展特别能激发学习文学史的学生的兴趣，因为在这个短暂的时期里，我们可以追溯各种戏剧以及许多伟大事业的开始、成长、全盛和衰落。

deceit.usage: de(不)+ceit(拿)→不诚实去拿→欺骗;派生deceitful adj.不诚实的

senses: v. 欺骗；蒙骗；诓骗；误导；使人误信
deceive.usage: de-（离开）+ceiv（拿）→用手段拿走→欺骗。族：deception n. 欺骗。近义：cheat v. 欺骗；【记】用天花乱坠的语言诱骗他去偷那个人。族deceptive a.欺骗性的；辨析:deceive侧重以假象使人上当;cheat着重用不诚实手段获利或害人;派生deceptive adj.骗人的；发音类似“

ex.en: Unless my eyes deceive me, that's his wife.
ex.zh: 如果我没有看错的话，那是他的妻子。

ex.en: a self-deceiving attempt
ex.zh: 一次自我欺骗式的尝试

ex.en: The company deceived investors about the true state of its finances.
ex.zh: 该公司在自身真实财务状况上欺骗了投资者。

ex.en: Clever packaging can deceive consumers into paying far more.
ex.zh: 精美的包装会诱使消费者支付高得多的价格。

ex.en: The tram began to decelerate as it approached the crowded station platform.
ex.zh: 电车在驶近拥挤的车站月台时开始减速。

deceleration.usage: n.减速 好的methodology 有很多merits。Nevertheless,orient 方法论的研究很大percentage 是passive 的， provincial 局限的，这些研究prolong 了结果的output。根据

ex.en: The bridge finally reopened in December, several weeks later than the engineers had promised.
ex.zh: 大桥最终于十二月重新开放，比工程师承诺的时间晚了好几周。

senses: a. 相当不错的；像样的
adj. 体面的；正派的；适当的；合宜的；合乎礼节的
adj. 相当不错的；体面的；正派的
decent.usage: 记：dec（合适）+-ent（形容词后缀）→穿衣打扮合适→得体的；同义respectable,proper,suitable,fit;反义indecent；adj.像样的；de（递）+cent（小钱、美分）→在美国递小费是合乎礼节的，过年给红包也是合乎礼节的→合礼节的，合宜的，得体的。；索引p406

ex.en: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.
ex.zh: 千禧一代被告知，如果你在学校表现出色，拿到一个体面的学位，你的一辈子就被安排妥当了。

ex.en: After years of part-time work, she finally found a decent job with health insurance.
ex.zh: 做了多年兼职后，她终于找到了一份带医疗保险的体面工作。

ex.en: Workers deserve a decent wage for an honest day's work.
ex.zh: 诚实劳动一整天，工人们理应得到像样的工资。

senses: n. 欺骗,蒙骗,诓骗;诡计,骗术,骗局

ex.en: The report reveals a deliberate deception practiced on investors for years.
ex.zh: 报告揭露了多年来对投资者蓄意实施的欺骗。

ex.en: He admitted that advertising often involves a degree of deception.
ex.zh: 他承认广告常常带有一定的欺骗性。

ex.en: Detecting deception is difficult even for trained interviewers.
ex.zh: 即使是受过训练的访谈者，识别欺骗也很困难。

ex.en: Analysts warned of the deceptiveness of the unemployment figures, which hid widespread part-time work.
ex.zh: 分析人士警告说，失业数据具有欺骗性，因为它掩盖了普遍的兼职就业现象。

decide.usage: v.使下决心；决定；裁决；v.使下决心；决定，选定；索引p406

ex.en: The committee will decide next week whether to fund the project.
ex.zh: 委员会将在下周决定是否为该项目提供资金。

ex.en: She decided to postpone her studies and work for a year.
ex.zh: 她决定推迟学业，先工作一年。

ex.en: The referee's decision in the final minute decided the outcome of the match.
ex.zh: 裁判在最后一分钟的判罚决定了比赛结果。

ex.en: The final match of the season will serve as the decider for the championship title.
ex.zh: 本赛季的最后一场比赛将成为决定冠军归属的决胜局。

senses: n. [U] 在特定地区杀死大量动物、植物或人的行为
n. 毁灭,大量杀戮;大幅削减

ex.en: The decimation of bee populations threatens the pollination of crops across the entire region.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂数量的大量消亡威胁着整个地区农作物的授粉。

decision.usage: n.决定；决断力；作决定；n.决定，抉择；判决；决断力； 作决定；索引p406

ex.en: The board's decision to close the plant angered local workers.
ex.zh: 董事会关闭工厂的决定激怒了当地工人。

ex.en: Choosing where to study is one of the biggest decisions a student faces.
ex.zh: 选择在哪里学习是学生面临的最重大的决定之一。

ex.en: The final decision rests with the committee, not with public opinion.
ex.zh: 最终决定权在委员会，而不在舆论。

decisive.usage: 记：de-（加强意义）+cis（切）+-ive→医生切除肿瘤时不犹豫→果断的；索引p406

ex.en: Climate was a decisive factor in establishing where the tournament should be held.
ex.zh: 气候是决定比赛地点的决定性因素。

ex.en: The manager's decisive response to the recall prevented lasting damage to the brand.
ex.zh: 经理对召回事件的果断处理防止了品牌受到持久损害。

ex.en: The final goal proved decisive in a match that both teams had dominated in turns.
ex.zh: 在这场两队交替占优的比赛中，最后那个进球被证明是决定性的。

ex.en: Dawna Markova would most probably agree that decisiveness derives from fantastic ideas.
ex.zh: 道娜·马尔科娃很可能会同意：决断力来源于奇妙想法。

ex.en: Voters praised the mayor's decisiveness during the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 选民称赞市长在金融危机期间的果断。

ex.en: In an emergency, decisiveness matters more than careful calculation.
ex.zh: 在紧急情况下，果断比周密计算更重要。

senses: v. 朗诵;大声宣布,慷慨陈词
v. 慷慨陈词；慷慨激昂地宣讲
declaim.usage: v.慷慨陈词；朗读；de（向下）+claim（喊）→在台上向下喊→慷慨激昂地演讲

ex.en: The famous actor declaimed a poem at the beginning of the show.
ex.zh: 这位著名的演员在演出开始时朗诵了一首诗。

ex.en: The senator rose to declaim against the proposed tax increase.
ex.zh: 这位参议员起身高声抨击拟议的增税方案。

ex.en: He loved to declaim on the decline of public manners.
ex.zh: 他喜欢慷慨陈词，大谈公共礼仪的沦丧。

senses: n. 宣言,宣布,公告,正式声明
declaration.usage: 记：de-（加强意义）+clar（清楚）+-ation→公开表态说明清楚某事→声明；n.声明；申报；宣布；The Declaration of Independence《独立宣言》

ex.en: The country issued a formal declaration of neutrality at the outbreak of war.
ex.zh: 该国在战争爆发时发表了正式的中立声明。

ex.en: Travellers must make a declaration of any goods above the duty-free limit.
ex.zh: 旅客必须申报任何超过免税限额的物品。

ex.en: The signing of the declaration of independence drew huge crowds to the square.
ex.zh: 《独立宣言》的签署吸引了大批民众来到广场。

senses: v. 公布；宣布；宣告；表明；宣称；断言
declare.usage: 辨析:declare正式场合郑重宣布;announce首次向公众宣布;proclaim官方正式宣布国家大事；v.宣布；断言，宣称；申报；发音类似“弟可累了”→弟弟可累了，“宣布”不干了；辨析：指明确地、正式地宣布或宣告，多用于官方场合；索引p406

ex.en: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.
ex.zh: 该命令还宣布，州和地方政府也不能监管宽带提供商。

ex.en: The outbreak of swine flu that was first detected in Mexico was declared a global epidemic on June 11, 2009.
ex.zh: 猪流感最初是在墨西哥被发现的，那场猪流感大爆发于2009年6月11日被宣布为全球性疫情。

ex.en: The region was declared a disaster area after the flood destroyed thousands of homes.
ex.zh: 洪水摧毁数千所房屋后，该地区被宣布为灾区。

decline.usage: v.下降，衰退 n.减少，衰退；de（向下）+clin（倾斜）+e→向下倾斜，就是“下降”→下降。；词根记忆：de(down,向下)+clin(bend,弯曲)+e→向下弯腰谢绝→谢绝；vi. 衰退义另考（2021年完形）；索引p406

ex.en: Microsoft declined to comment.
ex.zh: 微软拒绝作出评论。

ex.en: The number of students applying for language courses has declined sharply in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，申请语言课程的学生数量急剧下降。

ex.en: Scientists spent years trying to decode the ancient script carved on the temple walls.
ex.zh: 科学家们花了多年时间试图破译刻在神庙墙壁上的古老文字。

senses: vt. 装饰；授给(某人)勋章(或奖章)
decorate.usage: de(弟弟)+cor(core核心)+ate→弟弟主要想法是装饰房子→装饰；索引p406

ex.en: Hilton is building its own hotel there, which you may be sure will be decorated with Hamlet Hamburger Bars.
ex.zh: 希尔顿正在那里修建自己的酒店，可以肯定，酒店会配有哈姆雷特汉堡酒吧。

ex.en: The children decorated the classroom with paper flowers for the New Year party.
ex.zh: 孩子们用纸花装饰教室，迎接新年晚会。

ex.en: They hired a designer to decorate the apartment in a simple northern European style.
ex.zh: 他们请了一位设计师，以简约的北欧风格装修公寓。

senses: n. 装饰品,装饰图案,装饰风格,(房屋内部的)装饰,装潢;勋章,奖章
decoration.usage: n.装饰品；勋章；装饰风格；索引p406

ex.en: Mies held that elegance of architectural design was not reliant on abundant decoration.
ex.zh: 密斯认为，建筑设计的优雅并不依赖于丰富的装饰。

ex.en: The hotel's Christmas decorations attract visitors from across the region.
ex.zh: 这家酒店的圣诞装饰吸引了该地区各地的游客。

ex.en: The room was simple, with little decoration beyond a few paintings.
ex.zh: 房间十分简朴，除几幅画外几乎没有什么装饰。

ex.en: He was awarded a decoration for his bravery during the rescue.
ex.zh: 他因在救援中的英勇表现而获得一枚勋章。

senses: adj. 装饰性的，作装饰用的

decrease.usage: diminish 的近义词；v./n.减少，降低；词根记忆：de(表否定)+cre(grow,发展)+ase→向下发展→减少；索引p406

ex.en: Sales decreased by ten percent following the price increase.
ex.zh: 提价之后，销售额下降了百分之十。

ex.en: There has been a steady decrease in the number of smokers.
ex.zh: 吸烟人数一直在稳步减少。

ex.en: The decrease in traffic accidents is largely due to stricter speed limits.
ex.zh: 交通事故的减少主要归因于更严格的车速限制。

senses: v. 把……奉献给；题献词；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼
dedicate.usage: de-(加强)+dic(说)+ate→宣称归属→奉献；[族] dedication n. 奉献；de-（加强）+dic（说）+ate→说定→奉献。近义：devote vt. 奉献；致力于；v.致力于，献身于；把...献给；千百计记单词：dedi（发音类似daddy“爸爸”）+ cat（猫咪）+ e → 爸爸把自己的一生

ex.en: He dedicated his life to helping the poor.
ex.zh: 他毕生致力于帮助穷人。

ex.en: Job security or stability was the second most important career goal, followed by a sense of being dedicated to a cause or to feel good about serving the greater good.
ex.zh: 工作保障或稳定是第二重要的职业目标，随后是事业奉献感或服务于宏大高尚事业的满足感。

ex.en: She dedicated her first album to her husband.
ex.zh: 她把自己的第一张专辑献给了她的丈夫。

ex.en: But those who have no axe to grind...
Job security or stability was the second most important career goal (work-life balance was number one), followed by a sense of being dedicated to a cause.
ex.zh: 工作保障或稳定曾是第二重要的职业目标（工作与生活的平衡是第一位的），其次是一种献身于一项事业的感觉。

deduce.usage: de-(向下)+duc(引导)→向下引导→推论；v.推断，演绎；索引p406

ex.en: From the size of the fossil, scientists deduced the animal's probable weight.
ex.zh: 根据化石的大小，科学家推断出这种动物可能的体重。

ex.en: Detectives deduced from the wet umbrella that the suspect had arrived on foot.
ex.zh: 侦探从湿漉漉的雨伞推断，嫌疑人是步行到达的。

ex.en: Attentive readers can deduce the ending from small hints dropped early in the novel.
ex.zh: 细心的读者可以从小说前部埋下的小线索中推断出结局。

senses: a. 可扣除的；可减免的
deductible.usage: adj.可扣除的，可减免的 n.免赔额；索引p406

ex.en: Business travel expenses are deductible from taxable income under the new rules.
ex.zh: 根据新规定，商务差旅费用可从应税收入中扣除。

ex.en: The insurance plan has a high deductible, which keeps the monthly payments low.
ex.zh: 这份保险的免赔额很高，因此月缴保费较低。

ex.en: Check which medical costs are deductible before filing your tax return.
ex.zh: 在报税前先核实哪些医疗费用可以扣除。

deed.usage: 助记:deer(鹿)在很deep(深的)水里deed(行动)；索引p406

ex.en: He was honoured for his brave deed in saving two children from the river.
ex.zh: 他因从河中救出两名孩子的勇敢行为而受到表彰。

ex.en: Kind deeds, however small, can brighten a stranger's day.
ex.zh: 善举无论多小，都能照亮陌生人的一天。

ex.en: The lawyer checked the deed before the house was sold.
ex.zh: 房子出售前，律师核查了契约。

ex.en: The committee deemed the research proposal too costly to fund.
ex.zh: 委员会认为该研究计划成本过高，不值得资助。

ex.en: Customers may return any item they deem unsatisfactory within thirty days.
ex.zh: 顾客可在三十天内退回任何他们认为不满意的商品。

ex.en: The court deemed the contract invalid because both parties had signed under pressure.
ex.zh: 法院认定该合同无效，因为双方都是在压力下签署的。

senses: a. 深的；有……深的；深沉的；强烈的
adj. 深的,深刻的,深切的

ex.en: The miners worked deep underground, where temperatures often exceed forty degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 矿工们在很深的地下作业，那里温度常常超过四十摄氏度。

senses: adj. 根深蒂固的;强烈的;坚定的

ex.en: The number of deer in the national park has risen sharply, damaging young trees.
ex.zh: 国家公园里鹿的数量急剧增加，损害了幼树。

senses: v. 诽谤,中伤,破坏名誉

ex.en: The court ruled that the article had defamed the scientist by misquoting her research.
ex.zh: 法院裁定该文章因错误引用这位科学家的研究而构成诽谤。

senses: n. 违约(尤指未偿付债务);默认值
v. 违约,不履行义务(尤指不偿还债务)
default.usage: n.不履行，违约；默认，系统 设定值 v.违约，不履行；默认，预设；de(表加强)+fault(错误)→这家公司犯了一个严重的错误，“违约”了；词根记忆: de(表加强)+fault(deceive, 欺骗)→重大欺骗→违约；索引p406

ex.en: Most people stick with default settings.
ex.zh: 大多数人都坚持着默认设定。

ex.en: The company defaulted on its loans after sales fell for three years in a row.
ex.zh: 销售额连续三年下滑后，该公司拖欠了贷款。

ex.en: Please change the default password immediately, since every user of the system knows it.
ex.zh: 请立即修改默认密码，因为系统的每个用户都知道它。

senses: n. 失败；战败；挫败；战胜
v. 击败，战胜；使失败，挫败
defeat.usage: 发音类似"得废他"→得击败他、战胜他→击败；索引p406

ex.en: The goal is to defeat the enemy by whatever means possible.
ex.zh: 目标是尽一切可能击败敌人。

ex.en: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration's effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
ex.zh: 但是在宪法这一更重要的问题上，这个决定对于努力想打破联邦政府和各州政府之间权力平衡的当局来说却是一个8:0的溃败。

ex.en: The party suffered a heavy defeat in the general election.
ex.zh: 该党在大选中惨败。

ex.en: The champion was defeated by a young challenger in straight sets.
ex.zh: 卫冕冠军被一位年轻挑战者直落数局击败。

defect.usage: de（联想成"弟弟"）+fect（做）→弟弟做事常常会有"缺陷"

ex.en: The creative aspects of advertisement, for instance, often cover up the defects or problems in products.
ex.zh: 例如，广告的创意往往掩盖了产品的缺陷或问题。

ex.en: The manufacturer recalled the cars after engineers discovered a defect in the braking system.
ex.zh: 工程师发现制动系统存在缺陷后，制造商召回了这些汽车。

ex.en: No one is without defect; we learn to work with one another's weaknesses.
ex.zh: 人无完人；我们要学会包容彼此的缺点。

senses: adj. 有缺陷的；有缺点的

ex.en: Her hearing was found to be slightly defective.
ex.zh: 经检查，她的听力有点缺陷。

senses: v. 防御；保护；保卫；辩护；辩白
defend.usage: 发音类似"提防的"→提防敌人入侵，保护国家安全→保护；保卫

ex.en: The role of the military is to defend the country.
ex.zh: 军队的作用是保卫国家。

ex.en: The lawyer defended the company's decision, citing safety regulations.
ex.zh: 律师援引安全法规，为公司的决定辩护。

ex.en: Soldiers are trained to defend the base against surprise attacks.
ex.zh: 士兵们接受训练以保卫基地免遭突袭。

ex.en: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
ex.zh: 已有足够多的（新技术的）影响可以被察觉，甚至是显而易见的，因此，法官们能够也应该为警方、律师以及被告提供与时俱进的指导原则。

senses: n. 后卫；捍卫者；保卫者
defender.usage: n.防守队员；保护者，捍卫者；defend 的派生词

ex.en: The attacks on ambition are many and come from various angles; its public defenders are few and unimpressive.
ex.zh: 对野心的攻击有很多，而且来自不同的角度；它的公开辩护人很少，也不引人注目。

senses: n. 辩护；保护；防御(物)；[D-]国防机构
defense.usage: 2015年阅读例：The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing. 她辩护成功主要是因为她一无所知

ex.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
ex.zh: 快速做出决定可能是重要的防御机制；如果要判断某人是否会带来危险，我们的大脑和身体会无意识地在几毫秒内快速做出反应。

senses: adj. 可辩解的,合乎情理的,有正当理由的;可防御的,可守护的
adj. （想法，行为等）合理的；可拥护的
defensible.usage: adj.有正当理由的；可防御的；索引p406

ex.en: The committee judged that the spending cuts were logically defensible.
ex.zh: 委员会认为削减开支在逻辑上站得住脚。

ex.en: A theory must be defensible with evidence before it gains wide acceptance.
ex.zh: 一种理论必须能以证据支撑，才能获得广泛认可。

ex.en: The castle was built on a defensible hill overlooking the valley.
ex.zh: 这座城堡建在一座易守难攻的小山上，俯瞰山谷。

defer.usage: de（往下）+fer（拿）→往下拿（放）→推迟，延期。；索引p406

ex.en: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
ex.zh: 这也是为什么近年来立法改革屡次失败的原因，使得邮政服务无力支付各种账单，只能推迟至关重要的现代化（进程）。

ex.en: In the U.S., the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year.
ex.zh: 在美国，《2002年萨班斯—奥克斯利法案》已促使大多数上市公司推迟一年左右发放高层管理人员的绩效奖金。

ex.en: Students may defer their admission for one year to complete military service.
ex.zh: 学生可以推迟一年入学以完成兵役。

ex.en: Heavier women are less likely to develop calcium deficiency than thin women.
ex.zh: 在女性当中，胖人缺钙的概率要低于瘦人。

ex.en: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to bone problems in children.
ex.zh: 维生素D缺乏会导致儿童骨骼问题。

ex.en: The audit revealed serious deficiencies in the company's financial controls.
ex.zh: 审计揭示了该公司财务控制上的严重缺陷。

deficient.usage: de（不，非，使相反）+fic（做）+i（I，我）+ent→我做反了→有缺陷

ex.en: Their food is deficient in iron.
ex.zh: 他们的食物缺铁。

senses: n. 赤字，亏损，逆差；缺少
deficit.usage: de（表示"向下"）+fic（做）+it→经济往下做→经济走下坡路→亏损，赤字；索引p406

ex.en: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
ex.zh: 过去五年来贸易状况一直是逆差。

ex.en: The country's budget deficit widened as tax revenues fell.
ex.zh: 随着税收减少，该国预算赤字扩大。

ex.en: A sleep deficit can impair memory as severely as alcohol.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足对记忆的损害可能与酒精一样严重。

ex.en: The growing trade deficit forced the government to rethink its export policy.
ex.zh: 不断扩大的贸易逆差迫使政府重新考虑其出口政策。

senses: v. 定义；解释(词语的含义)
define.usage: 同义:set,clarify,explain;派生:definable可下定义的；v.给……下定义；阐明；界定；de(表示"往下")+fin(范围)+e→范围不断缩小，概念越来越具体→定义；索引p406

ex.en: Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it's as if they already know that their degree won't define them in the same way.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子或女儿永远不会说这样的话;似乎他们已经知道他们的学位永远不会以同样的方式定义自己。

ex.en: It is difficult to define what makes him so popular.
ex.zh: 很难解释清楚什么原因使他如此走红。

ex.en: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
ex.zh: 法国以自己是全球时尚的创新者而自豪，但现在它确定其时尚产业已经失去了对女性形体美的绝对定义权。

senses: adj. 明确的,肯定的,限定的
adj. 明显的，确定的，明确的
definite.usage: 记 de-(加强意义)+finit(界限)+e→界限清楚的→明确的；adj.清晰的，明晰的；确定的； 肯定的 n.确定之事；de(表示"往下")+fin(范围)+ite(形容词后缀)→范围不断缩小，概念越来越具体的→确定的，明确的

ex.en: Google can give us the powerful illusion that all questions have definite answers.
ex.zh: 谷歌会给我们一个强大的错觉，即所有的问题都有明确的答案。

ex.en: There is no definite evidence linking the two events.
ex.zh: 没有确凿证据表明这两起事件有关联。

ex.en: We need a definite answer before Friday.
ex.zh: 我们需要在周五之前得到明确的答复。

ex.en: Doctors gave a definite diagnosis after the second scan.
ex.zh: 医生在第二次扫描后给出了明确的诊断。

definitely.usage: adv.肯定地，当然；明确地，确 定地；索引p406

ex.en: The new regulation will definitely affect small online retailers.
ex.zh: 新规定肯定会影响小型网络零售商。

ex.en: She will definitely need more data before publishing her conclusion.
ex.zh: 在发表结论之前，她肯定还需要更多数据。

ex.en: Prices have definitely fallen since the new suppliers entered the market.
ex.zh: 自新供应商进入市场以来，价格确实下降了。

ex.en: People haven't yet reached agreement on its definition.
ex.zh: 人们尚未就它的定义达成一致。

ex.en: The dictionary gives several definitions of the word, each tied to a different context.
ex.zh: 词典给出了这个词的几个定义，每个定义都对应不同的语境。

ex.en: In scientific terms, the definition of the meter depends on the speed of light.
ex.zh: 从科学上讲，米的定义取决于光速。

deforestation.usage: 联想记忆：de(away，去掉)+forest(森林)+ation(名词后缀)→去掉森林→砍伐森林；索引p406

senses: vt. 违抗；使成为不可能

ex.en: The protesters defied the ban and gathered in the main square.
ex.zh: 抗议者公然违抗禁令，聚集在主广场上。

ex.en: The beauty of the landscape seems to defy description.
ex.zh: 这片风景之美似乎难以言表。

ex.en: The new data defy the widely accepted explanation of the phenomenon.
ex.zh: 新数据使人们广为接受的对该现象的解释难以成立。

ex.en: What began as a peaceful protest degenerated into violent clashes with the police.
ex.zh: 一场原本和平的抗议演变成了与警方的暴力冲突。

senses: v. 降低……身份,侮辱……的人格,使受屈辱
v. (使)退化;降解,分解;降低,削弱(尤指质量)
vt. 降低…身份；使受屈辱；使恶化
degrade.usage: 词根记忆: de(down, 向下)+grad(go, 走)+e→向下走→降级；索引p406

ex.en: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
ex.zh: 而诸如正义、公平、容忍、均衡和责任则成为被边缘化的字眼。

degree.usage: 另：doctoral degree博士学位；to some degree/to a certain degree在（某 种）程度上；索引p406

ex.en: She holds a degree in economics from a leading university.
ex.zh: 她拥有一所顶尖大学的经济学学位。

ex.en: To some degree, the company's failure reflects poor management.
ex.zh: 在某种程度上，该公司的失败反映出管理不善。

ex.en: Water boils at one hundred degrees at standard atmospheric pressure.
ex.zh: 在标准大气压下，水在一百度沸腾。

senses: n. 延期；耽搁；延误；延迟（或耽搁、拖延）的时间
delay.usage: 辨析:delay常指因外界因素拖延;postpone常指人为推迟；v./n.推迟，延期；延误，耽搁；de（发音类似“地”）+lay（发音类似“雷”）→路上遇到了地雷，因此“耽搁”了。；千百计记单词：de（向下）+ lay（放置）→ 放下来不做 → 耽搁。；谐音记忆：de(得)+lay(累)→累得走不动了，导致延迟到达→

ex.en: It's also a good idea to delay the conversation if you are in a meeting or other public space.
ex.zh: 如果你在开会或其他公共场合，推迟谈话也是个好主意。

ex.en: We must delay our journey until the weather improves.
ex.zh: 我们必须推迟旅行，直到天气好转。

ex.en: ...delay was because an old woman with a walking stick...
Sometimes storms blew the vessels far off their course, and often calm brought unbearably long delay.
ex.zh: 有时候，暴风雨使得船只严重偏离航线，而风平浪静又常常令船只超长时间滞留。

senses: v. 挑选或委派某人作代表
n. 代表 / v. 授权，委托
delegate.usage: 动词读ˌdelɪˈgeɪt;派生delegation n.代表,委托；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ leg（法律）+ ate（吃）→ “法律”上“离开”去“吃”饭的人是“代表”。

ex.en: The boss delegated the task to his assistant.
ex.zh: 老板把任务委托给了他的助手。

ex.en: Many a delegate was in favor of his proposal.
ex.zh: 许多代表赞成他的建议。

delete.usage: 派生deletion n.删除,删除部分；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ let（让）+ e → 让它离开 → 删除。；delete 指删除文字/文件；deletion n. 删除。

ex.en: Once you have a first draft on paper, you can delete material that is unrelated to your thesis.
ex.zh: 一旦你在纸上有了初稿，你就可以删除与你的论文无关的材料。

ex.en: You can delete this file if you don't need it.
ex.zh: 如果你不需要这个文件，可以删除它。

ex.en: He deleted the file from the computer.
ex.zh: 他从电脑中删除了该文件。

senses: a. 故意的；深思熟虑的
adj. 慎重的,深思熟虑的
deliberate.usage: adj.读di'librət;v.读di'libəreit；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ liberate（解放，使自由）→ 放弃自由，需要深思熟虑—仔细考虑。；索引p406

ex.en: They deliberated on whether to continue with the talks.
ex.zh: 他们仔细考虑了是否继续谈判的问题。

ex.en: And the best way to learn how to encode information meaningfully was a process known as deliberate practice.
ex.zh: 学习对信息进行有意义地编码的最佳方法是一种被称为刻意练习的过程。

ex.en: Deep breaths can help, as can speaking more slowly and deliberately.
ex.zh: 深呼吸会有所帮助，更缓慢更谨慎地讲话也会管用。

ex.en: It was a deliberate attempt to provoke a dispute.
ex.zh: 那是蓄意挑衅。

ex.en: There is a marked difference between the education which every one gets from living with others and the deliberate educating of the young.
ex.zh: 每个人在同他人相处时受到的教育和对年轻人的刻意教育之间有着明显的差异。

deliberately.usage: adv.故意地；从容不迫地，小 心翼翼地；索引p406

ex.en: Deep breaths can help, as can speaking more slowly and deliberately.
ex.zh: 深呼吸会有帮助，说话时语速慢一些、从容一些也会有帮助。

ex.en: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues.
ex.zh: 安贝迪怀疑，深思使他们将注意力集中在那些生动但具有误导性的信号上了。

senses: a. 精致的；微妙的；脆弱的
adj. 易碎的，脆弱的；微妙的；精巧的，精致的，精美的；熟练的
adj. 易碎的，脆弱的；微妙的；精巧的，精致的，精美的
delicate.usage: 派生:delicacy n.细致,优美,敏感；adj.脆弱的；精密的；微妙的； 精致的，精巧的；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ lic（诱惑）+ ate（吃）→ 经不起“诱惑”就吃，“诱人”的食物很“精美”→ 精致的。；索引p406

ex.en: Parents still have a major role to play, but now it is more delicate.
ex.zh: 父母仍然发挥着重要作用，只是现在这作用更加微妙。

ex.en: The fine-spun craft of hand weaving, a delicate work that takes weeks of concentrated effort to complete, has been developed over the course of tens of thousands of years.
ex.zh: 精纺手织工艺是一件精细的活儿，需要数周的专注努力才能完成，这一工艺是历经数万年发展起来的。

ex.en: delicate situations
ex.zh: 微妙的局势

senses: adj. 美味的;令人愉快的
adj. 美味的，可口的；有趣的
delicious.usage: 千百计记单词：de（离开）+ lici（诱惑）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ 诱人的 → 美味的。；千百计记单词：de（加强）+ lici（=lic 诱惑）+ ous（形容词后缀，表性质）→ 非常诱人的 → 美味的。

ex.en: The food is delicious and cheap.
ex.zh: 食物美味又便宜。

ex.en: They are also expensive, and delicious.
ex.zh: 它们也很贵，而且很美味。

ex.en: The dishes here are delicious and the prices are reasonable.
ex.zh: 这里的菜肴美味可口，价格也合理。

senses: n. 高兴,快乐;乐事,乐趣

phrases.m: 以某事物(做某事)为乐,尤指残忍的或坏事

delight.usage: 助记:de(加强)+light(光,光亮)→充满阳光→快乐;派生delightful adj.令人高兴的；adj.高兴的；de(表加强)+light(使明亮)→使心情明亮→高兴

ex.en: He looked up at his father, his features overflowing with energy and delight.
ex.zh: 他抬头看着父亲，脸上洋溢着活力和喜悦。

ex.en: To the delight of fans, the band announced a world tour.
ex.zh: 令歌迷高兴的是，乐队宣布举行世界巡演。

ex.en: The children screamed with delight when the snow began to fall.
ex.zh: 开始下雪时，孩子们高兴得尖叫起来。

ex.en: Her latest novel has delighted critics and ordinary readers alike.
ex.zh: 她的最新小说让评论家和普通读者都感到欣喜。

senses: v. 投递,传送,运输;发表,宣布
deliver.usage: de(分离)+liver(肝)→把心肝(宝贝)分离出来→给(产妇)接生；发音类似"递礼物"→投递礼物给我→递送；传送；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ liver（肝脏）→ 把货物从“肝脏”里“离开”运出去 → 递送。；联想记忆：de(递)+liver(肝)→快递员交付给我的都是心肝宝贝→交付；索引p406

ex.en: We promise to deliver within 48 hours.
ex.zh: 我们承诺在48小时内送到。

ex.en: The goods will be delivered within a week.
ex.zh: 货物将于一周内送达。

ex.en: ... Amazon and Google are working on same-day delivery...
ex.zh: 亚马逊和谷歌正在致力于当日送达服务。

delivery.usage: n.递送，投递；分娩；deliver 的派生词；索引p406

ex.en: The service guarantees next day delivery.
ex.zh: 这项服务保证第二天交货。

ex.en: Free delivery is offered on all orders placed before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前下的所有订单均免运费。

ex.en: The delay in the delivery of parts halted the whole production line.
ex.zh: 零部件交付延误使整条生产线停了下来。

ex.en: Complications during delivery are far less common than a century ago.
ex.zh: 如今分娩并发症远比一个世纪前少见。

senses: n. 错觉;妄想;误会;欺骗

ex.en: He was under the delusion that the company would recover without any major reforms.
ex.zh: 他抱有一种错觉，以为不需要任何重大改革公司也能复苏。

demand.usage: 千百计记单词：de（加强）+ mand（命令）→ 强烈要求 → 要求。；索引p406

ex.en: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.
ex.zh: 在这些社会中，对接受高等教育的要求增加，扩大到那些在战前没想过上大学的群体和社会阶层。

ex.en: Their demand for a pay raise was refused.
ex.zh: 他们加薪的要求被拒绝了。

ex.en: ... meet the growing demand...
ex.zh: 满足日益增长的需求。

senses: n. 民主，民主制；民主国家
democracy.usage: n.民主政体；民主国家；民主， 民主精神；千百计记单词：demo（人民）+ cracy（统治）→ 人民统治 → 民主。；索引p406

ex.en: In a direct democracy, citizens take turns governing themselves.
ex.zh: 在直接民主政体中，公民轮流自治。

ex.en: The new government promises to restore democracy.
ex.zh: 新政府承诺恢复民主。

ex.en: A free press is often described as the lifeblood of democracy.
ex.zh: 新闻自由常被称为民主的命脉。

senses: n. 民主党人,民主主义者
n. [D-]（美国）民主党党员；民主主义者

ex.en: As a committed democrat, he argued that power should rest with ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 作为一名坚定的民主主义者，他主张权力应归于普通公民。

ex.en: The Democrat senator voted against the immigration bill.
ex.zh: 这位民主党参议员投票反对移民法案。

ex.en: He described himself as a democrat who believed in the wisdom of ordinary voters.
ex.zh: 他自称是一名民主主义者，相信普通选民的智慧。

senses: adj. 民主的；民主政体的；民主制度的；（美国）民主党的
adj. 民主的；有民主精神的；[D-]（美国）民主党的
democratic.usage: adj.平等的，有民主精神的； 民主的；demo(人民)+crat(管理)+ic(形容词后缀)→由人民进行管理的→民主的；词根记忆：demo(人民)+crat(统治)+ic(…的)→由人民统治的→民主的；索引p406

ex.en: It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit.
ex.zh: 这给人的感觉不像是一种人际关系或民主关系，即便双方都获益。

ex.en: Free elections are considered the foundation of any democratic society.
ex.zh: 自由选举被视为任何民主社会的基础。

ex.en: The club takes a democratic approach, letting every member vote on key issues.
ex.zh: 这家俱乐部采取民主做法，让每位成员就关键议题投票。

ex.en: The reform aims to make the selection process more democratic.
ex.zh: 这项改革旨在使遴选过程更加民主。

ex.en: There is "the democratizing uniformity of dress and discourse, and the casualness and absence of deference" characteristic of popular culture.
ex.zh: 在这里，大众文化有“在服饰和谈吐方面有着民主化的一致性，漫不经心且不拘礼节”的特点。

senses: n. [sing.] （尤指特定年龄段的）人群
adj. 人口统计学的，人口统计的
adj. 人口（学）的；人口统计（学）的

phrases.p: the demographics of a newspaper's readership

demographic.usage: 记：demo（人民）+graph（记录）+-ic→记录下来的人民数量→人口统计数据；索引p406

ex.en: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
ex.zh: 这一想法就是要促使社会科学家将他们的工作同其他领域的工作相结合，包括健康和人口变化、食品安全、海洋研究和生物经济、清洁且高效的能源，以及包容、创新、安全的社会等。

ex.en: An ageing population is the most significant demographic trend facing Europe.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化是欧洲面临的最重要的人口结构趋势。

ex.en: Marketing teams study demographic data to identify their potential customers.
ex.zh: 营销团队研究人口统计数据以识别潜在客户。

senses: ②(用实验、实例等)说明，教，表明
③示范，宣传(产品)用法 ④游行，示威

phrases.p: demonstrate the ability to do sth.

demonstrate.usage: 同义 prove，illustrate，display，show；/ ˌ demən'streɪʃn/ 2 n.演示，展示；游行，示 威；证实 / ˈ demənstreɪtə( r)/ 0 n.示威者；演示者；发音类似"呆萌是对的"→表现自己的呆萌是对的；千百计记单词：de（加强）+ monstr（表示）+ ate（

ex.en: Alvarez's experience demonstrates the importance of finding ways to diffuse stress.
ex.zh: 阿尔瓦雷斯的经历表明，找到化解压力的方法是很重要的。

ex.en: The salesman demonstrated how to use the machine.
ex.zh: 推销员演示了如何使用这台机器。

ex.en: ... to demonstrate the importance of the plan...
ex.zh: 证明该计划的重要性。

ex.en: During the Renaissance, the great minds of Nicolaus Copernicus, Johannes Kepler and Galileo Galilei demonstrated the power of scientific study and discovery.
ex.zh: 文艺复兴期间，尼古拉·哥白尼、约翰内斯·开普勒以及伽利略·伽利雷等伟大的思想家都证明了科学研究与发现的力量。

ex.en: The study demonstrates the effectiveness of the drug.
ex.zh: 这项研究证明了该药物的有效性。

senses: n. 示威游行；示范；证明
n. 示威游行;展示;证明;示范
n. 示范；示范表演；演示；示威游行；证明；证实；论证；说明
n. 展示；示范；游行示威

ex.en: Thousands joined the demonstration against the new labour law.
ex.zh: 数千人参加了反对新劳动法的示威游行。

ex.en: The engineer gave a practical demonstration of how the robot works.
ex.zh: 工程师对机器人的工作原理作了实地演示。

ex.en: The experiment provides a clear demonstration of the underlying principle.
ex.zh: 这个实验清楚地证明了其背后的原理。

senses: n. [U] 士气低落；道德败坏
n. 堕落,道德败坏;士气低落
demoralization.usage: n.堕落；道德败坏；士气低落；索引p406

ex.en: Years of frozen pay led to widespread demoralization among the staff.
ex.zh: 多年工资冻结导致员工普遍士气低落。

ex.en: Managers underestimated the demoralization caused by constant reorganisation.
ex.zh: 管理层低估了频繁重组造成的士气低落。

ex.en: The coach's first task was to reverse the team's demoralization after five straight defeats.
ex.zh: 教练的首要任务是扭转球队五连败后的士气低落。

ex.en: The government's flat denial of the scandal convinced neither the press nor the public.
ex.zh: 政府对这起丑闻的断然否认既未能说服新闻界，也未能说服公众。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

senses: vt. 表示；是……的标志；意思是
denote.usage: 同义 indicate，mean，imply，show；v.代表，表示，意指；索引p406

ex.en: In the diagram, the red line denotes the average temperature.
ex.zh: 在图中，红线表示平均气温。

ex.en: A falling birth rate often denotes long-term economic anxiety.
ex.zh: 出生率下降往往标志着长期的经济焦虑。

ex.en: The mark in the margin denotes a passage worth reading again.
ex.zh: 页边标记表示有一段文字值得重读。

ex.en: Opposition leaders denounced the new tax as unfair to low-income families.
ex.zh: 反对派领导人谴责新税收对低收入家庭不公平。

senses: adj. 密度大的,浓的;愚蠢的
adj. 密集的，稠密的；难懂的
adj. 密集的，稠密的，浓密的
adj. 稠密的；(烟、雾等)浓重的；密度大的
dense.usage: 千百计记单词：de（加强）+ nse → 密密麻麻的 → 密集的。；真 dense forest 茂密的森林；索引p406

ex.en: The colonists' first glimpse of the new land was a sight of dense woods.
ex.zh: 首先映入这些殖民者眼帘的是新大陆的大片茂密树林。

ex.en: The area has a dense population.
ex.zh: 这个地区人口稠密。

ex.en: The dense fog reduced visibility on the motorway to a few metres.
ex.zh: 浓雾使高速公路上的能见度降至几米。

ex.en: The report is so dense that few readers ever finish it.
ex.zh: 这份报告过于艰深，几乎没有读者能读完。

density.usage: n.稠密，密集；密度；真 reduce the density of forests 降低森林的密度；索引p406

ex.en: The population density of the city is very high.
ex.zh: 这个城市的人口密度非常高。

ex.en: Housing density in the city centre has doubled since the year 2000.
ex.zh: 自2000年以来，市中心的住房密度翻了一番。

ex.en: Scientists measured the density of the liquid at different temperatures.
ex.zh: 科学家测量了该液体在不同温度下的密度。

ex.en: Low population density makes public transport expensive to run in rural areas.
ex.zh: 人口密度低使农村地区的公共交通运营成本高昂。

phrases.m: 某人不健康的牙齿状况

dental.usage: 记：dent（牙齿）+-al（形容词后缀）→牙齿的；千百计记单词：dent（牙齿）+ al（形容词后缀）→ 牙齿的。

ex.en: I have a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
ex.zh: 我下午三点有一个牙科预约。

ex.en: Poor dental care in childhood can cause problems in later life.
ex.zh: 童年时期牙科护理不当会在以后的生活中引发问题。

ex.en: The clinic offers free dental check-ups for children from low-income families.
ex.zh: 该诊所为低收入家庭的儿童提供免费牙科检查。

dentist.usage: 记：dent（牙齿）+-ist（名词后缀）→治疗牙齿疾病的人→牙科医生

ex.en: Regular visits to the dentist can prevent small cavities from developing into serious problems.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小蛀牙发展成严重问题。

senses: vt. 拒绝；否认；拒绝承认
v. 否认，否定；拒绝承认
v. 否认，拒绝承认；拒绝给予
vt. 否认，不承认；拒绝给予
deny.usage: 另 There is no denying the fact that... 无可否认……；v.否认；拒绝承认；拒绝 给予；发音类似“抵赖”→抵赖不就是“否认”做过的事情吗；千百计记单词：de（相反）+ ny（=nay 说“不”）→ 说“不” → 否认。；deny doing sth（不接 to do）；denial

ex.en: He denied having stolen the money.
ex.zh: 他否认偷了钱。

ex.en: There is no denying that...
ex.zh: 不可否认的是……

ex.en: He denied having seen the document.
ex.zh: 他否认见过这份文件。

ex.en: The EU is faced with so many problems that it intends to deny the possibility of devaluation.
ex.zh: 欧盟(EU)面临的问题太多，以至于它打算杜绝货币贬值的可能性。

senses: v. 离开，出发，启程；离职
depart.usage: 助记:de(分离)+part(离开)→离开；千百计记单词：de（离开）+ part（部分）→ 与整体分离 → 离开。；发音类似"弟怕他"→弟弟因为怕他所以就"离开"了；串词记忆：那对情侣离职(depart)后也分手(part)了；索引p406

ex.en: The train departs at 6 p.m.
ex.zh: 火车下午六点发车。

ex.en: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
ex.zh: 当利亚姆·麦吉于8月卸任美国银行行长时，他的解释出乎意料地直接。

ex.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
ex.zh: 1908年到1915年间，约有700万人来(美国)，与此同时约有200万人离开。

senses: n. 部；司；局；处；系；（医院的）科；（大型商店的）货品区
department.usage: de(分开)+part(部分)+ment(名词后缀)→把一个东西分成一个个部分→机构的"部门"；辨:department指一个单位中的某个部门如Finance Department财政部;bureau一般指警局或其他局级别单位如the Federal Bureau of Investigation联邦调查局；索引p40

ex.en: He works in the physical education department.
ex.zh: 他在体育系工作。

ex.en: The sales department blames the delivery delays on the new software.
ex.zh: 销售部门将交货延误归咎于新软件。

ex.en: She has taught in the economics department for fifteen years.
ex.zh: 她在经济学系任教已经十五年。

ex.en: The department issued new guidelines on handling customer data.
ex.zh: 该部门就处理客户数据发布了新的指导原则。

departure.usage: 助记:depart(离开)+ure(名词后缀)→离开；词根记忆：de(分开)+part(部分)+ure(名词后缀)→离开；索引p406

ex.en: Following the explosion of creativity in Florence during the 14th century known as the Renaissance, the modern world saw a departure from what it had once known.
ex.zh: 14世纪时，佛罗伦萨创造力迸发，人们将这个阶段称为文艺复兴时期，现代世界随之告别了其过去所知的一切。

ex.en: Passengers should arrive at the airport two hours before departure.
ex.zh: 乘客应在起飞前两小时到达机场。

ex.en: The sudden departure of the chief engineer delayed the project by months.
ex.zh: 总工程师的突然离职使项目拖延了数月。

ex.en: The new policy marks a sharp departure from previous practice.
ex.zh: 新政策标志着与以往做法的明显背离。

phrases.p: depend on sb. to do sth.

depend.usage: 派生 dependable adj. 可信赖的，可靠的；索引p406

ex.en: The success of the project will depend largely on government funding.
ex.zh: 该项目的成败将在很大程度上取决于政府拨款。

ex.en: Many elderly people depend on public transport to do their shopping.
ex.zh: 许多老人依靠公共交通购物。

ex.en: Whether the plan works depends on how quickly the new rules are enforced.
ex.zh: 计划是否奏效取决于新规执行得有多快。

ex.en: The country's heavy dependence on imported grain left it vulnerable to global price shocks.
ex.zh: 该国对进口粮食的严重依赖使其容易受到全球价格冲击的影响。

senses: n. (尤指不正常或不必要的)依靠,依赖;附属国,附属地

ex.en: Critics argue that long-term dependency on foreign aid discourages local industries from developing.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，长期依赖外国援助会阻碍当地产业的发展。

senses: adj. 依靠的，依赖的；取决于……的
dependent.usage: 千百计记单词：depend（依赖）+ ent（形容词后缀）→ 依赖的。；索引p406

ex.en: The country is heavily dependent on oil exports.
ex.zh: 这个国家严重依赖石油出口。

ex.en: The crop remains heavily dependent on the weather, despite modern irrigation systems.
ex.zh: 尽管有现代灌溉系统，这种作物仍在很大程度上取决于天气。

ex.en: Many elderly people are dependent on relatives or social services for daily care.
ex.zh: 许多老人在日常生活上依靠亲属或社会服务。

ex.en: The murals depict everyday life in the city at the turn of the twentieth century.
ex.zh: 这些壁画描绘了二十世纪之交这座城市的日常生活。

senses: v. (常用被动态)大量减少,耗尽,使枯竭
deplete.usage: 派生depletion n.消耗,用尽,耗减

ex.en: Decades of overfishing have severely depleted fish stocks in the North Sea.
ex.zh: 数十年的过度捕捞已严重耗竭北海的鱼类资源。

senses: v. 公开谴责;强烈反对
v. 部署,调度(军队或武器)
v. 部署，调度（军队或武器）；有效地利用
deploy.usage: 派生deployment n.部署,调度；v.部署，调度；利用；弟弟（de）去海里捕捞（ploy），必须“部署”好行动和人员。；索引p406

ex.en: Tanks were deployed effectively during the long campaign.
ex.zh: 在这场旷日持久的战役中，坦克部队得到了有效的部署。

ex.en: Kids need plenty of practice delaying gratification and deploying effective organizational skills, such as managing time and setting priorities.
ex.zh: 孩子需要大量练习“延迟满足”能力和运用有效的组织技能，比如管理时间和分清事情的轻重缓急。

ex.en: The company deployed the new software across all of its branches.
ex.zh: 公司在所有分部部署了新软件。

ex.en: Extra police were deployed to control the crowds during the festival.
ex.zh: 节日期间，警方增派警力控制人群。

senses: ③将(钱)存入银行 ④付(保证金)
n. ①沉淀物 ②存款 ③保证金
deposit.usage: 同义 store，lay，place；de(往下)+pos(联想成pose"放")+it(它)→水流过之后就要放下来一些"沉积物"；父母每个月挣钱都要放下一些"存款"→沉积物；存款

ex.en: You can withdraw and deposit money in any of our branches.
ex.zh: 你可在我们任何一家分行办理存取款业务。

ex.en: Tenants must pay a deposit equal to one month's rent before moving in.
ex.zh: 租客入住前必须支付相当于一个月房租的押金。

ex.en: The river deposits rich soil across the plain during flood season.
ex.zh: 汛期，河流将肥沃的土壤沉积在平原上。

ex.en: Environmental groups documented the depredation of the wetlands by unregulated building firms.
ex.zh: 环保组织记录了无监管的建筑公司对湿地造成的破坏。

senses: v. 使沮丧；使萧条；降低，减少
depress.usage: 同义 sadden，discourage；反义 encourage；派生 depressed 抑郁的，depressing 令人沮丧的；v.使抑郁；降低；按下；de(往下)+press(按，压)→总有一种往下压的感觉→使沮丧

ex.en: What depresses me most is that I never see you.
ex.zh: 最让我沮丧的是我再也见不到你了。

ex.en: The long recession depressed wages across the whole region.
ex.zh: 长期衰退压低了整个地区的工资水平。

ex.en: Weeks of constant rain depressed everyone stuck indoors.
ex.zh: 连绵数周的阴雨让困在室内的人们情绪低落。

ex.en: Depress the clutch fully before changing gear.
ex.zh: 换挡前请将离合器踩到底。

depressed.usage: 词根记忆：de(down, 向下)+press(按压)+ed(形容词后缀)→向下压的→沮丧的；索引p406

ex.en: If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing.
ex.zh: 如果你意志消沉，你就不会自我提高。

senses: adj. 令人沮丧的，令人消沉的

ex.en: After months of fruitless job hunting, he described the whole experience as deeply depressing.
ex.zh: 经过数月毫无结果的求职后，他把整段经历描述为令人非常沮丧。

ex.en: Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men.
ex.zh: 与男性相比，女性在应对压力时，特别容易感到抑郁和焦虑。

ex.en: The Great Depression of the 1930s threw millions of workers out of jobs.
ex.zh: 20世纪30年代的大萧条使数百万工人失业。

ex.en: He fell into a deep depression after losing his job.
ex.zh: 失业后，他陷入了严重的抑郁。

deprive.usage: 辨析：deprive sb./sth. of sth. 剥夺；overthrow 推翻，颠覆；confront 常与 with 连用，使面对；punch 常与 in 连用，给某物穿孔；反义 entitle 给予权利；派生 deprived adj. 被剥夺的，贫困的；v.剥夺，使丧失；免去……的 职务；v.剥夺，使丧失

ex.en: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
ex.zh: 委员会忽视了几十年来美国大学和学院培养的毕业生不了解人文教育的内容和特点，因此他们也无法从中受益。

ex.en: No child should be deprived of education because of family poverty.
ex.zh: 任何孩子都不应因家庭贫困而被剥夺受教育的机会。

phrases.m: 在最深处;在最严峻的时刻

depth.usage: 词组(be/get)out of one's depth不能理解

ex.en: The interview revealed the depth of her knowledge of international trade law.
ex.zh: 这次面试显示出她对国际贸易法的深厚造诣。

deputy.usage: 多想有个“副手”啊，可以把工作往下（de）放（put）给他。；索引p406

ex.en: Deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
ex.zh: 副总裁们也许会更愿意在没有新职位的情况下跳槽。

ex.en: The deputy director will attend the conference in place of the minister.
ex.zh: 副部长将代替部长出席会议。

ex.en: She was appointed deputy editor of the journal last year.
ex.zh: 她去年被任命为该期刊的副主编。

senses: n.[U] 撤销管制；解除控制

derive.usage: de-（向下）+riv（河）+e→自河流源头向下延伸→源于。近义：acquire vt. 获得。；辨析：derive 得到、取得，常用 derive from；discern 认出、辨别、识别；diminish 减少、缩小；displace 代替、移置、替换；弟弟（de）沿着河（rive，联想river）走，寻找河的源

ex.en: This income was derived directly from his writing.
ex.zh: 这笔收入直接来源于他的写作。

ex.en: Elegance, he believed, did not derive from abundance.
ex.zh: 他认为，优雅并非来自繁多。

ex.en: The English word salary derives from a Latin term for salt.
ex.zh: 英语单词 salary 源自一个表示盐的拉丁语词。

senses: v. 下来，下降；降临，来临
descend.usage: de（向下）+scend（=climb爬，攀）→向下爬→下来；索引p406

ex.en: Night descends quickly in the tropics.
ex.zh: 热带地区天黑得快。

ex.en: The plane descended rapidly before making an emergency landing in a field.
ex.zh: 飞机在一片田地紧急降落前迅速下降。

ex.en: The path descends steeply toward the village at the foot of the mountain.
ex.zh: 小路陡然下斜，通向山脚下的村庄。

descendant.usage: n.后裔，子孙；衍生物；发音类似“第三代的”→子女的子女是第三代→后代；索引p406

ex.en: Many of them are descendants of the original settlers.
ex.zh: 他们中许多人都是早期移民的后裔。

ex.en: We have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
ex.zh: 我们现在已经充分了解了塑造地球历史的长期模式，了解了我们人类这一物种，足以对我们的后代将来所处的形势进行基于证据的预测。

ex.en: She is a direct descendant of a famous eighteenth-century painter.
ex.zh: 她是一位十八世纪著名画家的直系后代。

senses: n. 下降，降落；血统；祖籍

ex.en: Most European languages have a common descent.
ex.zh: 大多数欧洲语言都有共同的起源。

senses: vt. 描述；把……称为；画出……图形
describe.usage: 词根记忆：de(down，向下)+scrib(write，写)+e→写下→描述；词根script, scrib：to write写；索引p406

ex.en: Witnesses described the suspect as a tall man in his thirties.
ex.zh: 目击者描述嫌疑人为三十多岁的高个子男子。

ex.en: It is hard to describe the excitement of landing your first job.
ex.zh: 获得第一份工作的兴奋之情难以形容。

ex.en: The report describes in detail how the accident unfolded.
ex.zh: 报告详细描述了事故发生的经过。

ex.en: The police issued a detailed description of the missing child.
ex.zh: 警方发布了失踪儿童的详细描述。

ex.en: The scenery was beautiful beyond description.
ex.zh: 那里的风景美得难以形容。

ex.en: His lecture gave a vivid description of life in the Arctic.
ex.zh: 他的讲座生动描述了北极的生活。

desert.usage: de（否定）+sert（加入，插入）→不再加入→离开，抛弃。

ex.en: Pull down the deserted shopping mall.
ex.zh: 拆除废弃的购物中心。

ex.en: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.
ex.zh: 撒哈拉是世界上最大的炎热沙漠。

ex.en: Many farmers deserted their villages to seek work in the cities.
ex.zh: 许多农民抛弃村庄进城谋生。

phrases.m: 应该受到某人好的/坏的待遇

deserve.usage: [族]deservedly ad. 当之无愧地；同义 merit, earn；派生 deserving adj. 该受赏的，有功的；值得的；v.值得，应受；de（得）+serve（服务）→我花了钱就应该得到相应的服务→应得。；词根记忆：de(向下)+serv(服务)+e→值得从上到下的服务→值得；索引p406

ex.en: The company deserves no subsidy because ticket prices can be raised to cover the spending.
ex.zh: 该公司不应该得到补贴，因为它可以提高票价来弥补这些支出。

ex.en: The moral decaying deserves more research by sociologists.
ex.zh: 道德沦丧值得社会学家进行更多的研究。

ex.en: Workers who put in extra effort deserve recognition from their employers.
ex.zh: 付出额外努力的员工理应得到雇主的认可。

senses: vt. 设计；（为特定目的）计划；制订
design.usage: 派生 designedly adv. 有计划地，故意地；designing n. 设计(术)；n.设计，布局，安排；意图 v.设计；n.设计，布局，安排；构思 v.设计；索引p406

ex.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
ex.zh: 哈格尔说，我们在美国设计了大量这种工作，它们趋向于“严格符合规定”，并且“高度标准化”，以致没有任何发挥“个人主动性或创造力”的余地。

ex.en: The bridge's elegant design has won several international awards.
ex.zh: 这座大桥优雅的设计屡获国际大奖。

ex.en: The course is designed for students with no prior programming experience.
ex.zh: 这门课程是为没有任何编程经验的学生设计的。

ex.en: Poor street design contributes to many accidents in the city centre.
ex.zh: 街道设计不佳是市中心许多事故的诱因之一。

senses: adj. 已任命但未就职的
v. 指派，委任；命名，指定；标明
designate.usage: v.任命，指定；标明，标示 adj.已当选而尚未上任的；design（设计）+ate（动词后缀）→指派某人，任命某人；词根记忆:de(表加强)+sign(记号)+ate(做)→做记号→指定；索引p406

ex.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered", a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
ex.zh: 他们曾敦促该机构将这一鸟类认定为“濒危物种”，这一定位会给予联邦官员更大的监管权力，以打击对该物种的威胁。

ex.en: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as "endangered".
ex.zh: 他们曾敦促该机构将该鸟类标示为"濒危物种"。

ex.en: The eastern part of the island has been designated a nature reserve.
ex.zh: 该岛的东部已被指定为自然保护区。

senses: adj. 由著名设计师设计的,标有设计师姓名的,名牌的

ex.en: The designer spent two years perfecting a chair that could be flat-packed for shipping.
ex.zh: 这位设计师花了两年时间完善一种可扁平包装以便运输的椅子。

senses: a. 令人满意的；可取的
adj. 可取的；值得拥有的；值得做的
adj. 令人向往的；值得拥有的；可取的
desirable.usage: adj.令人向往的，值得拥有的； 性感的；de(弟弟)+sir(长官)+able(形容词后缀)→弟弟努力成为长官是"值得做的"；索引p406

ex.en: Such measures are desirable, if not essential.
ex.zh: 这些措施即使不是必要的，也是可取的。

ex.en: It is desirable that applicants have some experience of working with children.
ex.zh: 理想的情况是申请人有一些与儿童打交道的经验。

ex.en: The house stands in a desirable location, close to schools and subway stations.
ex.zh: 这所房子位置令人向往，靠近学校和地铁站。

ex.en: He resisted the desire to check his phone during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他克制住了在会议中查看手机的欲望。

ex.en: The desire for a better life drove millions of people to move to the cities.
ex.zh: 对更好生活的渴望驱使数百万人迁往城市。

ex.en: The committee expressed a strong desire to settle the dispute out of court.
ex.zh: 委员会表达了强烈的愿望，希望庭外解决争端。

ex.en: Each new employee is given a desk, a laptop and a copy of the staff handbook.
ex.zh: 每位新员工都会得到一张办公桌、一台笔记本电脑和一本员工手册。

senses: adj. 孤独凄凉的,可怜的
desolate.usage: 助记:de(加强)+sol(孤独的)+ate(动词后缀)→使感到凄凉;派生desolation破坏,蹂躏

senses: v. 绝望；失去希望；丧失信心
despair.usage: 助记:des(分离)+pair(一对)→把一对情侣分离开→绝望；n./v.绝望；de(弟弟)+spair(联想pair一双)→弟弟买到限量鞋却丢了，快"绝望"了；索引p406

ex.en: Don't despair! We'll think of a way out of this.
ex.zh: 别灰心！我们会找到出路的。

ex.en: Rescuers refused to despair even after three days of searching the wreck.
ex.zh: 即使在搜寻残骸三天之后，救援人员也拒绝绝望。

ex.en: She sank into despair when the letter of rejection arrived a second time.
ex.zh: 当拒信第二次寄到时，她陷入了绝望。

senses: n. (公文)急件,书信,新闻报道
a. 绝望的；不顾一切的
adj. 绝望的,极其严重的
adj. 不顾一切的,拼死的
adj. 非常想要的；绝望的
desperate.usage: 派生desperately拼命地;desperation拼命,不顾一切；adj.不顾一切的；渴望的；绝望 的；词根记忆: de(表否定)+sper(hope, 希望)+ate→没有希望的→绝望的；索引p406

ex.en: He'd been through the dot-com boom and bust and, desperate for a job, signed on with a Boulder agency.
ex.zh: 在经历了互联网经济的兴衰之后，他急需一份工作，于是就与博尔德公司签了合约。

ex.en: Desperate for funding, the laboratory accepted money from a private foundation.
ex.zh: 由于急需经费，实验室接受了一家私人基金会的资助。

ex.en: The rescue team made a desperate attempt to reach the climbers before nightfall.
ex.zh: 救援队拼命想在夜幕降临前到达登山者所在的位置。

ex.en: Thousands of desperate families queued overnight for drinking water.
ex.zh: 数千个绝望的家庭连夜排队领取饮用水。

senses: adv. 不顾一切地；拼命地；极度地

ex.en: She looked desperately around for a weapon.
ex.zh: 她在四下里找，急于弄到一件武器。

senses: n. 绝望；拼命；不顾一切

ex.en: In desperation, the farmers sold their cattle at half the usual price to buy feed.
ex.zh: 走投无路之下，农民们以通常一半的价格卖掉牛来购买饲料。

despise.usage: de（表示向下）+spise（=spic看）→向下看某人就是“鄙视”他；索引p406

ex.en: Don't cheat at the examination, or your classmates will despise you.
ex.zh: 考试不要作弊，否则你的同学会看不起你。

ex.en: He despised flattery and valued honest criticism instead.
ex.zh: 他鄙视阿谀奉承，反而重视坦诚的批评。

ex.en: Some critics despise popular fiction, regarding it as mere entertainment.
ex.zh: 一些批评家鄙视通俗小说，认为它只是娱乐消遣。

senses: prep. 不管，不顾；即使，尽管
despite.usage: 介词，后面常接名词性结构；例为2013年新题型；索引p406

ex.en: Despite these factors, many social scientists seem reluctant to tackle such problems.
ex.zh: 尽管有这些因素，许多社会科学家似乎不愿意解决这样的问题。

ex.en: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
ex.zh: 尽管大雨倾盆，户外音乐会仍按计划举行。

ex.en: The firm remained profitable despite rising labour costs.
ex.zh: 尽管劳动力成本上升，该公司仍保持盈利。

senses: n. 正餐后的水果或甜食
dessert.usage: 在沙漠（desert）里如果能吃到甜点（dessert），那该多好啊！

ex.en: We finished off with a dessert of honey and nuts.
ex.zh: 我们最后吃了蜂蜜果仁甜点。

ex.en: Would you like some ice cream for dessert?
ex.zh: 甜点想来点冰淇淋吗？

ex.en: She cut down on desserts to control her weight.
ex.zh: 她减少吃甜点以控制体重。

ex.en: The island has become a popular tourist destination in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，这座海岛已成为热门旅游目的地。

ex.en: We reached our destination just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们恰在日落前到达目的地。

ex.en: The parcel was badly damaged between its origin and its destination.
ex.zh: 包裹在从寄出地到目的地的途中损坏严重。

senses: adj. 命中注定的；以…为目的地的
n. 命运,命中注定的事

ex.en: He believed that hard work, not fate, shapes a person's destiny.
ex.zh: 他相信塑造人的命运的是努力而非天命。

ex.en: The discovery of gold changed the destiny of the small town.
ex.zh: 黄金的发现改变了这座小镇的命运。

ex.en: Many immigrants saw America as a place where they could control their own destiny.
ex.zh: 许多移民把美国视为能够掌握自己命运的地方。

ex.en: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.
ex.zh: 摧毁即将取代我们工作的机器将是疯狂的。

ex.en: The wildfire destroyed thousands of hectares of forest.
ex.zh: 野火烧毁了数千公顷森林。

ex.en: False rumours can destroy a reputation built over decades.
ex.zh: 虚假谣言可以毁掉数十年建立起来的声誉。

ex.en: The old documents were accidentally destroyed during the office move.
ex.zh: 这些旧文件在办公室搬迁期间被意外销毁。

destruction.usage: 助记:destruct(破坏)+ion(名词后缀)→破坏；n.破坏，摧毁；索引p406

ex.en: The earthquake caused loss of life and property destruction.
ex.zh: 地震造成了生命和财产损失。

ex.en: The fire caused the destruction of two ancient wooden houses in the old street.
ex.zh: 大火烧毁了老街上两座古老的木屋。

ex.en: Environmentalists warn of the destruction of rainforests and the loss of countless species.
ex.zh: 环保人士警告雨林遭受破坏以及无数物种的消失。

senses: adj. 破坏性的,毁灭性的
destructive.usage: 派生destructively毁灭性地;destructiveness破坏,毁灭；索引p406

ex.en: Too much happiness can be destructive.
ex.zh: 乐极生悲。

ex.en: The hurricane proved far more destructive than early forecasts suggested.
ex.zh: 这场飓风的破坏力远超早期预报。

ex.en: Critics warned that jealousy is destructive to both friendship and teamwork.
ex.zh: 批评者警告说，嫉妒对友谊和团队合作都有破坏性。

senses: v. 分开，分离；分派，派遣
detach.usage: 同义 separate，disconnect，remove；反义 attach；派生 detached adj. 独立的，分离的；de（分开）+tach（接触）→不接触了→分开，分离。；词根记忆：de(向下)+tach(钉子)→拆下钉子→拆卸；索引p406

ex.en: One of the panels had become detached from the main structure.
ex.zh: 一块镶板已从主体结构上脱落。

ex.en: Otherwise, academics will continue to think dangerously alike, increasingly detached from the societies which they study, investigate and criticise.
ex.zh: 否则，大学教师会一直怀有这样危险的想法，愈加脱离他们所研究、调查和批判的社会。

ex.en: You can detach the keyboard from the tablet and use them separately.
ex.zh: 你可以把键盘从平板电脑上拆下来，分开使用。

senses: n. 细节，详情；细微之处，琐事
detail.usage: n.细节；详情，资料 v.详细说明，详述；派遣；de（除掉，分开，往下）+tail（=cut切）→分开切成小份→细节；索引p406

ex.en: Can you tell me the story in detail?
ex.zh: 你能详细地给我讲下这个故事吗？

ex.en: The contract spells out every detail of the delivery schedule.
ex.zh: 合同详细列明了交货时间表的每一个细节。

ex.en: The guidebook details the history of every major building in the city.
ex.zh: 这本旅游指南详述了城里每座主要建筑的历史。

detain.usage: 同义 arrest，delay；反义 liberate；派生 detainee n. 被拘留者；de（加强）+tain（拿）→强制拿住→拘留；耽搁

ex.en: The minister was unavoidably detained in Lisbon on affairs of state.
ex.zh: 部长因国家事务不可避免地被拘留在里斯本。

ex.en: Police may detain a suspect for questioning for up to twenty-four hours.
ex.zh: 警方可以将嫌疑人拘留讯问至多二十四小时。

ex.en: I was detained by an urgent phone call and arrived late for the meeting.
ex.zh: 我被一个紧急电话耽搁，开会迟到了。

senses: vt. 查明,测出,发现,察觉
vt. (当场)发现(某人在干坏事)

ex.en: People have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean.
ex.zh: 人们未能察觉到海洋中发生的巨大变化。

ex.en: To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
ex.zh: 为了查明这一情况是否适用于非生物，加州大学圣地亚哥分校的拉蕾·奎恩及其同事测试了老鼠是否能够察觉到机器鼠发出的社交信号。

ex.en: New sensors can detect tiny leaks in gas pipelines before accidents happen.
ex.zh: 新型传感器能在事故发生前探测到燃气管道的微小泄漏。

senses: n. 侦探；警探；私人侦探
detective.usage: 助记:detect(发现,查出,侦察,侦査)+ive(名词后缀)→侦察；n.私家侦探

ex.en: A team of around 30 detectives and uniformed officers have been working on the case.
ex.zh: 一个由大约30名侦探和穿制服的警察组成的小组一直在调查此案。

ex.en: The detective spent months collecting evidence before making an arrest.
ex.zh: 侦探在实施逮捕前花了几个月收集证据。

ex.en: Detective novels remain popular because readers enjoy solving the mystery themselves.
ex.zh: 侦探小说依然流行，因为读者喜欢亲自解开谜团。

detector.usage: 助记:detect(查出,侦査)+or(名词后缀,表示物)→探测器；n.探测器，检测器；发现者；索引p406

ex.en: Every passenger must pass through a metal detector at the airport.
ex.zh: 每位乘客都必须经过机场的金属探测器。

ex.en: A smoke detector in the stairwell alerted the family to the fire.
ex.zh: 楼梯间里的烟雾探测器向这家人发出了火灾警报。

ex.en: The mine is equipped with gas detectors linked to an automatic ventilation system.
ex.zh: 矿井装有与自动通风系统相连的气体检测器。

phrases.p: deter large retailers from trying their hand
phrases.m: 阻止大型零售商尝试自己的做法

ex.en: Harsh penalties alone will not deter young people from committing crimes.
ex.zh: 仅靠严厉惩罚并不能阻止年轻人犯罪。

ex.en: High prices have deterred many families from buying homes in the city.
ex.zh: 高昂的房价使许多家庭不敢在城里购房。

ex.en: Nothing could deter her from pursuing a career in science.
ex.zh: 什么都不能阻止她从事科学事业。

deteriorate.usage: deterior（更坏）+ate→变得更坏→恶化。近义：worsen v. 恶化；记：deterior（更坏）+-ate（动词后缀）→病情变得更坏了→恶化；v.恶化，变坏，衰退；事情的状况一直在恶化（deteriorate），我们必须想办法制止（deter）；索引p406

ex.en: But particularly when viewed against America's turbulent past, today's social indices hardly suggest a dark and deteriorating social environment.
ex.zh: 但是，尤其是与美国动荡的过去相比，如今的社会各项指标几乎都不能表明这是一个黑暗、恶化的社会环境。

ex.en: His health deteriorated rapidly in the months after he left hospital.
ex.zh: 出院后的几个月里，他的健康状况迅速恶化。

ex.en: Relations between the two countries deteriorated sharply after the border incident.
ex.zh: 边境事件后，两国关系急剧恶化。

ex.en: Her determination to succeed impressed everyone in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 她成功的决心给实验室里的每个人留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: With great determination, he taught himself programming during long night shifts.
ex.zh: 凭着极大的决心，他在漫长的夜班期间自学编程。

ex.en: The determination of the winner will be based on both speed and accuracy.
ex.zh: 获胜者的确定将同时依据速度和准确性。

ex.en: If circumstances always determined the life and prospects of people, then humanity would never have progressed.
ex.zh: 如果环境总是决定人们的生活和前途，那么人类就永远不会进步。

ex.en: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the mysterious illness.
ex.zh: 科学家正试图确定这种神秘疾病的病因。

ex.en: The amount of aid is determined by the severity of the disaster.
ex.zh: 援助数额由灾害的严重程度决定。

ex.en: She was determined to finish the marathon despite her injury.
ex.zh: 尽管受了伤，她仍决心跑完马拉松。

ex.en: The sudden devaluation of the currency made imported machinery far more expensive for local factories.
ex.zh: 货币突然贬值，使进口机械对当地工厂来说贵得多。

devalue.usage: vt.使（货币）贬值，降低（某 事物）的价值，贬低 vi.（货币）贬值；vt.使贬值；降低……的价值；de（向下）+value（价值）→把价值往下说→贬低；词根记忆：de(down,降低)+value(价值)→降低…的价值→贬低；索引p406

ex.en: Work in the home is often ignored and devalued.
ex.zh: 家务劳动常常被忽视和贬低。

ex.en: This way you devalue your opinion and show that you are incapable of managing your own life.
ex.zh: 这样你就贬低了自己的观点，并且表明你无法掌控自己的生活。

ex.en: The government devalued the currency to make exports more competitive.
ex.zh: 政府让货币贬值以增强出口竞争力。

senses: vt.&vi. 发展；开发；冲洗（照片）
vt. 发展；开发；冲洗（照片）
develop.usage: evolve 的近义词；②养成（习惯）2009年阅读；③患病2017年完形；④详尽阐述2008年新题型；索引p406

ex.en: Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
ex.zh: 欧洲委员会成员查理·迈克里维警告国际会计准则理事会，它“不是生活在政治真空中”，而是生活在“现实世界”里，欧洲迟早会制定不一样的规则。

ex.en: Children develop social skills through playing with their peers.
ex.zh: 儿童通过与同伴玩耍发展社交技能。

ex.en: The company plans to develop the old factory site into affordable housing.
ex.zh: 该公司计划把旧厂址开发成保障性住房。

senses: n. (新产品等的)开发者；开发商

development.usage: economic development经济发展；moral development道德发展；sustainable development可持续发展；索引p406

ex.en: The development of renewable energy has attracted record levels of private investment this year.
ex.zh: 可再生能源的开发今年吸引了创纪录的私人投资。

phrases.p: leave sb. to his own devices
phrases.m: 让某人自行应付,对某人不加干涉

device.usage: [近] equipment n. 设备；appliance 的近义词；索引p406

ex.en: Playing with digital device discourages kids from active discovery.
ex.zh: 玩数字设备会阻碍孩子积极探索。

ex.en: The lab invented a small device that measures air quality in real time.
ex.zh: 实验室发明了一种能实时测量空气质量的小型装置。

ex.en: Repeating the question was merely a device to gain time.
ex.zh: 重复这个问题只是拖延时间的手段。

phrases.p: between the devil and the deep (blue) sea

senses: v. 设计，发明，想出(办法)
devise.usage: v.设计，发明；de(表示"往下")+vis(表示"看"，如visit)+e→往下看→低头眼睛一转圈就想出一个点子→想出，设计；索引p406

ex.en: We must devise a new system for dealing with complaints.
ex.zh: 我们必须设计一个新的处理投诉的系统。

ex.en: The team devised a new method for recycling construction waste.
ex.zh: 团队想出了一种回收建筑垃圾的新方法。

ex.en: A special committee was set up to devise safety standards for drones.
ex.zh: 为制定无人机的安全标准，成立了一个特别委员会。

ex.en: She devised a training schedule that fit around her full-time job.
ex.zh: 她设计出一份能兼顾全职工作的训练计划。

devote.usage: de-(加强)+vot(许愿)→许下心愿→奉献；[族] devotion n. 献身；热爱；dedicate 的近义词；派生devoted献身的;专心的;devotion献身;忠诚;专心；v.献身，致力；用于；千百计记单词：de（发音类似“弟”）+ vot（发誓）+ e → 弟弟发誓要效忠祖国 → 奉献。；联想记忆:d

ex.en: I could only devote two hours a day to the work.
ex.zh: 我一天只能在这个工作上花两个小时。

ex.en: But if your work is your passion, you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it.
ex.zh: 如果你的工作是你的激情所在，你就更有可能全身心地投入其中。

ex.en: But if your work is your "passion", you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it.
ex.zh: 但是如果你的工作就是你的"热情"所在，你就更容易全情投入。

senses: adj. 挚爱的；忠诚的；全心全意的
devoted.usage: adj.挚爱的，忠诚的；专用 于……的

ex.en: Devoted concertgoers are missing the point.
ex.zh: 那些忠实的音乐会听众没有领会到问题的关键点。

ex.en: Her devotion to medical research earned her international recognition, though little financial reward.
ex.zh: 她对医学研究的献身精神为她赢得了国际声誉，却几乎没有带来经济回报。

ex.en: The spider webs hung heavy with dew, catching the first light of dawn.
ex.zh: 蛛网挂满露水，映出黎明的第一缕晨光。

ex.en: Doctors link the sharp rise in diabetes among children to diets high in sugar.
ex.zh: 医生将儿童糖尿病的急剧增多与高糖饮食联系起来。

diagnose.usage: 同义interpret,deduce,analyze；di（穿过）+a+gnos（知道）+e→需要X光穿过之后检查一下才能知道是什么疾病→诊断，判断

ex.en: The illness was diagnosed as cancer.
ex.zh: 此病被诊断为癌症。

ex.en: Doctors can now diagnose diabetes years before symptoms appear.
ex.zh: 如今医生能在症状出现前数年诊断出糖尿病。

ex.en: The mechanic quickly diagnosed the problem as a faulty fuel pump.
ex.zh: 修理工很快判断出问题出在燃油泵故障上。

ex.en: Early diagnosis of the disease greatly improves the patient's chances of full recovery.
ex.zh: 这种疾病的早期诊断能大大提高患者完全康复的机会。

ex.en: The garage uses advanced diagnostic equipment to identify engine faults within minutes.
ex.zh: 这家修理厂使用先进的诊断设备，几分钟内就能查明发动机故障。

diagram.usage: 派生diagrammatic图表的,只有轮廓的;助记:dia(通过)+gram(图)→图解

ex.en: The manual includes a clear diagram showing how to assemble the shelf without tools.
ex.zh: 说明书中附有一张清晰的图解，展示如何不用工具组装书架。
